text:
sre_alex: Alert -- noticed a 4.2x spike in queue depth for dedicated-us-west-2:reserved-3 starting ~03:10 UTC. Multiple customer 429s coming in. Pushing logs and quick metrics.

infra_maya: on it. can you paste the pool throughput and p99 tokens?

sre_alex: brief snapshot: 
```\npool: reserved-3
queue_depth: 842 -> 3560 (4.22x)
p95_latency: 1.2s -> 2.8s
p99_latency: 3.5s -> 9.4s
gpu_util: 78% -> 86%
requests_429_5m: 73
```

allocator-bot: AdmissionController: switched reserved-3 -> CAPACITY_BASED_THROTTLE (soft) at 03:12:07 UTC. Evicting non-critical fairshare entries.

eng_runtime_chris: looks like fairshare eviction + prefix-cache invalidation churn. I see a flurry of cache misses in KV store around the same time. Posting autoscaler logs.

infra_maya: did the autoscaler try to scale? i don't see any new node launches.

eng_runtime_chris: autoscaler attempted scale at 03:13:15 but API returned quota error: 
```\nRequest: scale pool reserved-3 +2
Response: 403 QuotaExceeded: ulimit-az-cores-us-west-2 (requested 16, available 0)
```

product_sam: customers affected include a couple of mid-market tier apps. Getting slack threads and support pings. SLA risk.

eng_platform_lee: any chance to route overflow to dedicated-burst-pool or hosted-fallback? We have routing policy but it was disabled for reserved-3.

sre_alex: routing policy is currently OFF for reserved-3 to prevent noisy neighbor. We can toggle to allow critical customers to fallback. Need sign-off.

cost_amy: fallback to hosted will spike spend (est ~3x for those tokens). need explicit ok from product/finance for extended fallback. Short window OK.

eng_sre_taylor: proposal: 1) temporarily raise per-tenant rate limit for flagged critical customers, 2) enable routing to dedicated-burst for non-latency-sensitive traffic, 3) open AZ quota ticket.

infra_maya: +1. I'll open cloud-quota ticket now (case 2026-3301). ETA for quota increase unknown.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: config-change/routing-enable (PR #5129) by eng_platform_lee. CI checks passing.

eng_platform_lee: rolling enabling routing fallback for reserved-3 -> dedicated-burst for requests with tag:fallback_allowed. Doing canary 1%.

sre_alex: can someone bump fairshare weight for critical-tenant-group to reduce their eviction probability?

eng_runtime_chris: done. ran: `rlsctl set-weight reserved-3 --group critical-tenant-group --weight 2.5` -> ack. Watching metrics.

infra_maya: autoscaler workaround: manual scale attempted but blocked by AZ quota. As a temporary workaround I cleared one draining server to free slots (low risk) -> pool capacity +1.

sre_alex: after weight bump + 1 freed server + routing canary, queue depth dropped from 3.5k -> 680 over 7 minutes. p95 ~ 320ms now. Monitoring.

product_sam: Good recovery. We need to notify the customers impacted with a short incident summary and ETA on permanent fix.

cost_amy: action item: estimate cost delta if fallback remains on for >6h. I'll do quick calc.

eng_sre_taylor: temporary policy change note: we allowed routing fallback and raised weights for critical group. We should record this in the incident channel and revert after capacity stable.

eng_runtime_chris: root-cause hypothesis: multi-tenant traffic burst + cache invalidation due to new model version rollout in reserved-3 earlier today (03:05 UTC) -> higher KV miss rate -> slower per-request processing -> admission kicked in and exposed AZ quota limits.

sre_alex: next steps (short):
- open postmortem ticket and collect eval logs (assigned: eng_runtime_chris)
- escalate AZ quota with cloud (assigned: infra_maya, case 2026-3301)
- update autoscaler fallback policy to allow a controlled burst route (eng_platform_lee)
- cost impact analysis for fallback durations >1h (cost_amy)

infra_maya: logging the temporary config change: `routing.enabled.reserved-3=true` (canary=1%). Will revert after 60m if stable.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout 1% -> success. No errors in 5m health checks.

sre_alex: monitoring: 03:28 UTC queue 480, 03:34 UTC queue 220. p99 coming down to 1.8s.

product_sam: I'll draft a customer comms piece and share in #customer-success for review.

eng_platform_lee: follow-up: we should add an autoscaler pre-check for AZ quotas and failover gracefully to bursting pools instead of hitting quota error path. I'll open an RFC.

eng_sre_taylor: noted. Also add a trigger to notify cloud-ops when pool enters CAPACITY_BASED_THROTTLE for >5m.

sre_alex: Closing Slack thread for now — monitoring continues. Will update last_message_ts after postmortem ticket created. Thanks everyone :tada:
